1.summary: This cycle marks the ambitious and creative beginning where new intentions are planted and hard work sets long-term karmic processes in motion.
description: The point of initiation. A moment to begin planting something new.
Symbolizes the first unit (year, month, or day) within a nine-part cycle.
Motivation arises to act on the physical plane.
What is initiated here—whether consciously or unconsciously, positively or negatively—will unfold across nine cycles. These karmic seeds must eventually be harvested, so choose with care.
This opening cycle carries strong positivity, ambition, creativity, and a pioneering spirit. Embrace it fully.
Take pleasure in dedicating effort toward what you love and intend to bring into form.

2.summary: This phase focuses on connection and relational growth as emerging ideas interact with their environment and are shaped by others.
description: A phase of connection and outreach, where the sprout breaks free and begins engaging with its environment.
On a human level, this period invites us to understand relationships, move beyond pure individuality, and explore our role within a wider social fabric.
Although development is slower than in the first cycle, growth and expansion continue.
During this time, we are more strongly affected by the energies and perspectives of others.

3.summary: A dynamic and creative phase of outward momentum where transformation accelerates, requiring both action and later introspection to avoid burnout.
description: A period of activation and forward momentum.
The central theme is the transformation of outdated patterns as we process and integrate what has been learned up to this point.
This is an energetic, lively, and generally uplifting time.
Letting go of elements from the past can feel difficult, yet it ultimately leads to greater clarity and light.
Creative energy and optimism are especially strong.
The second half of this cycle brings a decline in energy, so moderation is essential to prevent exhaustion. Make the most of the initial surge.
Energy moves outward during this phase, favoring tangible action and engagement with the physical world.
The latter half encourages self-reflection and inner review. Avoid pushing forward relentlessly, as this can lead to burnout.

4.summary: This inward-facing cycle emphasizes healing, rest, and intuitive reflection to clear obstacles and support authentic growth.
description: The call is toward self-reflection. A time to clear away what no longer serves.
This phase supports healing and purification on multiple levels, bringing attention to subtle factors that may be limiting growth.
Emotional sensitivity tends to be heightened during this period.
An opportunity to open inwardly and place trust in intuitive guidance.
Past karma may surface for resolution. Turning inward is necessary to address it.
True and sustainable growth emerges as a result.
A period that favors rest and gentleness with the body. Avoid excessive intensity or strain.
Practices such as fasting, cleansing, and conscious breathing are beneficial.
Remain connected to the inner realm, where deep and meaningful insights can be found.

5.summary: This is a fast-moving and change-oriented phase of exploration, communication, and expansion that requires grounding to remain productive.
description: A phase of outward expansion and reaching further—new ideas, fresh visions, and novel experiences emerge.
This period (year, month, or day) centers on change and finally acting on intentions that were previously postponed.
Highly inspirational energy is present, making grounding and realism essential. When balanced, significant progress can be achieved—break free and move forward.
Often associated with travel, relocation, or pursuing unfamiliar paths.
Clear expression and effective communication are important now—speak what needs to be spoken, but do so thoughtfully.
Remain aware of the tendency toward mental overactivity and an overload of ideas.

6.summary: This cycle centers on balance, resolution, and informed decision-making as emerging outcomes become visible but not yet complete.
description: A time to restore mental equilibrium, access a broader perspective, and make decisions guided by higher awareness.
Well-suited for resolving unfinished matters, whether related to relationships, finances, or family concerns.
This phase asks for comprehension and the attainment of inner resolution across all areas of life.
Intuition and rational thought come together to clarify the direction of our ongoing projects.
Within the plant metaphor, buds begin to open, revealing the early shape of what is forming, though full flowering has not yet occurred.

7.summary: A reflective and restorative phase where the results are visible, effort slows down, and self-honouring prepares the way for culmination.
description: A moment of blossoming, where the emerging creation can now be appreciated, even though it is not quite ready to be fully harvested.
This is a time to slow down, relax, and enjoy periods of quiet and non-action. The primary work of this cycle is complete.
Ideal for solitude and gentle pleasures such as reading, writing, or listening to music.
In everyday life, the first half may feel slow or slightly uneasy due to a lack of outward movement.
During the second half, momentum increases significantly as energy transitions toward the eighth cycle and the peak approaches.

8.summary: This is the peak manifestation phase where efforts culminate into tangible results, prosperity, and higher-order rewards.
description: A phase of fulfillment and manifestation. All prior cycles, beginning with the seed, have been guiding us here, with an emphasis on openness to receiving universal offerings.
The results of our efforts become fully visible and usable. What was held in conscious or subconscious intention now arrives with strength.
Whatever has been cultivated reaches its completed form.
In human affairs, this tends to be a prosperous period, often perceived as fortunate by those who believe in luck.
For those receptive to it, heightened universal energy can deliver higher-level gifts such as spiritual insight and evolutionary growth.

9.summary: The final phase, which invites deep reflection, integration, and conscious preparation for the beginning of a new cycle.
description: Completion has arrived. This is the moment to review the entire journey from a unified perspective, evaluate the cycle as a whole, and begin preparing for what comes next.
A potent phase for reflection and meditation. Clarify what occurred, acknowledge it honestly, integrate the lessons, and ready yourself for the next cycle.
